description: From the edge of Plaza de la Catedral, Cádiz's great cathedral rises baroque and neoclassical in one view, its golden dome glowing softly against the night sky. The tall bell towers flank the façade while warm plaza lamps wash the stone below, and a mild Atlantic breeze — about 24°C and perfectly clear — carries the sound of the sea around the old town. The cathedral, begun in 1722 and over a century in the making, feels like the glowing heart of one of Europe's oldest cities.
